## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for any behavior change, and `flutter test` passes (package and `example/`)
- [ ] `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .` and `flutter analyze` are clean
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] `dart pub publish --dry-run` still clean, if the public API changed
- [ ] README / `doc/` updated, if this changes documented behavior or platform capabilities
- [ ] No private platform APIs and no unverified capability claims
